full_judgment: 10. The High Court Division relying upon the decision in the case of Shishir Kant! Pal and others vs Nur Muhammad and others reported in 55 DLR(AD)39 observed that a registered document carries presumption of correctness of the endorsement and therefore Exhibit-'Ka' which is a registered document, the presumption was not dislodged. The High Court Division further observed that there is nothing on record that from the execution on 27.7.1976 and registration on 29.07.1976 of the deed Exhibit-2(Ka) no objection was raised by the heirs of Syed Ahmed with regard to the genuineness of the said deed nor any challenge was made seeking redress from any Court of law and defendant No. 1 has no locus standi or competence to challenge the genuineness of the said kabala. The High Court Division upheld the decision of the Courts below.
